b1.name: Buttermilk pancakes, scrambled egg, banana
steps: Stir 2 Tbsp lemon juice into the milk and let it stand 5 minutes to make buttermilk.
Whisk flour, sugar, 1 Tbsp baking powder, 1 tsp baking soda and 1 tsp salt. Whisk in the soured milk, 4 eggs and 4 Tbsp melted butter until just combined; small lumps are fine.
Cook 1/4-cup rounds on a lightly buttered griddle over medium heat, about 2 minutes a side, until golden.
Scramble the remaining 10 eggs in butter over medium-low heat until set.
Serve 2–3 pancakes with warm syrup, a spoonful of eggs and half a banana.
b1.temp: Eggs cooked until firm (155°F for hot-held egg dishes).

b2.name: French toast with syrup, banana
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, 2 tsp cinnamon, 1 Tbsp vanilla, 2 Tbsp honey and a pinch of salt in a shallow dish.
Soak each bread slice about 20 seconds a side.
Cook in butter over medium-low heat 3–4 minutes a side until golden and set in the middle.
Hold finished slices in a 275°F oven up to 15 minutes. Serve 2 slices with syrup and half a banana.

b3.name: Baked oatmeal with blueberries and apple, boiled egg
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Butter a 9×13 dish. Dice the apples and spread them in the dish with the blueberries.
Whisk milk, yogurt, 2 eggs, brown sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt and 1 tsp cinnamon. Stir in the oats and pour over the fruit.
Bake covered 20 minutes, then uncovered about 25 minutes until set and golden.
Boil the remaining 10 eggs 12 minutes, cool and peel. Serve a square of oatmeal with one egg.
b3.temp: Bake until the centre is set (155°F).

b4.name: Bacon, egg and potato breakfast casserole, toast, orange wedges
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Dice the potatoes and boil 8–10 minutes until just tender; drain.
Cook chopped bacon until crisp. Soften the diced onion and pepper in a little of the fat.
Whisk eggs with sour cream, 3/4 tsp salt and pepper. Layer potatoes, bacon, vegetables and half the cheese in a buttered 9×13 dish and pour the eggs over.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes. Uncover, add the rest of the cheese and broil 3–4 minutes.
Serve with buttered toast and orange wedges.
b4.temp: Egg casserole to 155°F in the centre.

b5.name: Fluffy scrambled eggs, buttered toast, apple slices
steps: Whisk eggs with the milk, 1/2 tsp salt and a little pepper until completely blended.
Melt 5 Tbsp butter in a large non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Add the eggs and let them sit 20 seconds.
Push the eggs gently from the edges to the centre in large folds until softly set, about 3–4 minutes. Take off the heat while still glossy.
Serve with buttered toast and thin apple slices.
b5.temp: Eggs cooked until firm, no liquid egg (155°F if hot-held).

b6.name: Banana bread, yogurt cup, grapes
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Butter and flour a 9×5 loaf pan.
Cream the softened butter and sugar. Beat in the eggs, then 3 mashed very ripe bananas and 1/2 tsp vanilla.
Stir in flour, 1 tsp baking soda and 1/2 tsp salt until just combined. Pour into the pan.
Bake 55–60 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes, turn out and slice into 10.
Serve a slice with a yogurt cup and halved grapes.
b6.temp: Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.

l1.name: Chicken noodle soup, dinner roll, apple slices
steps: Bring the broth and 6 cups water to a boil. Add skinless chicken thighs and simmer 20 minutes.
Sauté the chopped onion and celery in 2 Tbsp oil until golden; add to the pot with the sliced carrots.
Add the pasta and cook 15 minutes more. Lift out the chicken, shred it, discard bones and return the meat.
Season with salt-free seasoning, dill and one pressed garlic clove. Taste before adding salt.
Serve with a buttered roll and apple slices.

l2.name: Chicken salad sandwich with grapes, side salad
steps: Poach the chicken breasts in simmering salted water 15–18 minutes. Cool and dice.
Whisk mayonnaise, sour cream, 3 Tbsp lemon juice, chopped dill or parsley, 3/4 tsp salt and pepper.
Fold in the chicken, 3 cups halved grapes, sliced celery and finely chopped onion. Chill.
Serve on bread with a small green salad and the remaining grapes, halved. (The source recipe adds toasted pecans; they are left out here for easier chewing.)
l2.temp: Chicken to 165°F, then chill and hold at 41°F or below.

l3.name: Egg salad sandwich, side salad, orange wedges
steps: Boil the eggs 12 minutes, cool in ice water, peel and chop.
Mix mayonnaise, 4 tsp lemon juice, 4 tsp Dijon mustard, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp paprika and pepper.
Fold in the eggs with finely chopped celery, onion, dill and chives. Chill.
Serve on bread with a small green salad and orange wedges.
l3.temp: Hold egg salad at 41°F or below.

l4.name: Apple tuna salad sandwich, side salad, apple slices
steps: Drain the tuna well and flake it into a bowl.
Add finely diced onion, one diced apple and the diced avocado.
Stir in the mayonnaise, 1 tsp lemon juice and pepper. Chill.
Serve on bread with a small green salad and apple slices. (The source recipe adds toasted almonds; left out here.)
l4.temp: Hold tuna salad at 41°F or below.

l5.name: Minestrone soup with Parmesan, dinner roll
steps: Cook chopped bacon in a large pot until golden. Add chopped onion and 3 minced garlic cloves; cook 2 minutes.
Add diced celery, carrot, zucchini and potato; cook 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, broth, 3.5 cups water, tomato paste, 1 Tbsp Worcestershire and the drained beans. Cover and simmer gently 30 minutes.
Add the small pasta and drained green beans; simmer 10 minutes more until the pasta is soft.
Stir in the Parmesan. Serve with a roll.
l5.temp: Bring to a full simmer (165°F); reheat leftovers to 165°F.

l6.name: Mild beef and bean chili with cheese, crackers
steps: Sauté the diced onion and 3 minced garlic cloves in 3 Tbsp oil until soft.
Add the ground beef and brown, breaking it up. Drain excess fat.
Add drained beans, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, 1.75 cups water, 1.5 Tbsp mild chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 1 Tbsp brown sugar, 1.5 tsp salt. Leave out the cayenne.
Simmer 20–30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Serve topped with cheese and sour cream, with crackers.
l6.temp: Ground beef to 155°F; reheat leftovers to 165°F.

l7.name: Chicken and cheese quesadilla, sour cream, side salad
steps: Poach or bake the chicken until cooked through, then shred.
Soften the diced pepper and onion in 1 Tbsp oil. Add the chicken, taco seasoning and 1/2 cup water; simmer until the liquid is gone.
Spread filling and cheese over half of each tortilla and fold.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan over medium-low heat 3–4 minutes a side, or bake at 400°F 8–12 minutes, until crisp and melted.
Cut in wedges. Serve with sour cream and a small green salad.

d1.name: Beef stew with potatoes, carrots and peas, salad, dinner roll
steps: Cut the tri-tip into 1-inch cubes. Toss with the flour, 3/4 tsp garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Brown the beef with the chopped onion in 4 Tbsp oil in a large pot.
Add the broth (beef base or bouillon may be stirred in for colour), scraping the bottom. Add cubed potatoes, carrots, celery, tomato paste and 1 tsp dried rosemary.
Cover and simmer on medium-low 1 to 1.5 hours until the beef is very tender.
Thicken with 2.5 Tbsp cornstarch stirred into cold water. Add the peas and cook 5 minutes. Serve with salad and a roll.
d1.temp: Simmer until tender (well above 155°F); reheat leftovers to 165°F.

d2.name: Glazed meatloaf, mashed potatoes, green beans, dinner roll
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Soften the finely chopped onion in 1 tsp oil.
Mix beef, onion, eggs, 4 minced garlic cloves, 3 Tbsp ketchup, breadcrumbs, 1/2 cup milk, 1.25 tsp salt, 1.25 tsp Italian seasoning and pepper. Press into a lined loaf pan.
Bake 40 minutes. Stir the remaining ketchup with 2 tsp vinegar, the brown sugar, garlic powder and onion powder; spread over the loaf and bake 20 minutes more.
Boil peeled, cubed potatoes until tender; mash with butter and the rest of the milk, warmed.
Rest the meatloaf 10 minutes, slice into 10. Serve with mashed potatoes and heated green beans.
d2.temp: Meatloaf to 160°F in the centre (ADHS minimum for ground beef is 155°F).

d3.name: Shepherd's pie with mixed vegetables, steamed broccoli, dinner roll
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Boil peeled potatoes until tender; mash with warm cream, salt, Parmesan and the beaten egg.
Brown the beef in 1 Tbsp oil with salt and pepper. Add chopped onion and 3 minced garlic cloves; cook until soft.
Stir in the flour, then the broth, tomato paste and 1 Tbsp Worcestershire. Simmer until thick, then add the frozen vegetables.
Spread the filling in a 9×13 dish, top with the potatoes and brush with melted butter.
Bake 25–30 minutes until golden. Serve with steamed broccoli.
d3.temp: Ground beef to 155°F; pie hot through (165°F).

d4.name: Baked salmon with lemon and Dijon, rice, broccoli, salad
steps: Heat oven to 450°F. Line a rimmed pan and lay the salmon on it, cut into 10 portions of about 4 oz.
Stir 3 Tbsp oil, 3 Tbsp lemon juice, 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 Tbsp Dijon, chopped parsley, 3/4 tsp salt and pepper. Spread over the fish.
Bake uncovered 12–15 minutes until it flakes easily. Check carefully for bones before serving.
Cook the rice in 5 cups water with a pinch of salt, 18 minutes covered. Steam the broccoli until soft and toss with butter.
Serve with a small green salad.
d4.temp: Salmon to 145°F at the thickest part.

d5.name: Chicken pot pie, green beans, salad
steps: Poach the chicken until cooked, then shred (about 5 cups). Heat oven to 425°F.
Melt the butter in a deep pan. Cook chopped onion, sliced carrots and mushrooms about 8 minutes; add 4 minced garlic cloves.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then the broth and cream. Simmer until thick. Season with 2 tsp salt and pepper; add the chicken, peas and parsley.
Line a deep dish with one crust, fill, top with the second crust, crimp, cut vents and brush with beaten egg. For 10 residents use a 9×13 dish with crust on top only.
Bake 30–35 minutes until deep golden. Rest 15 minutes. Serve with green beans and salad.

d6.name: Baked ziti with Italian sausage and ricotta, green beans, salad
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Brown the sausage with the diced onion; drain the fat.
Add the pasta sauce, diced tomatoes, 2/3 cup water and 2.5 tsp Italian seasoning. Simmer 10 minutes.
Boil the pasta 2 minutes less than the package says, drain and toss with the sauce.
Mix ricotta, egg, parsley and 1 cup of the mozzarella. Layer half the pasta, all the ricotta, then the rest of the pasta in a 9×13 dish. Top with the remaining cheeses.
Bake uncovered 25–30 minutes until bubbly. Serve with green beans and salad.

d7.name: Oven-baked chicken drumsticks, rice, green beans, corn, salad
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Pat the 20 drumsticks dry.
Toss with 3 Tbsp oil, 1 Tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt and pepper.
Space out on two lined baking sheets. Bake about 40 minutes, turning once.
Cook the rice in 5 cups water, 18 minutes covered. Heat the green beans and the corn with the butter.
Serve 2 drumsticks each; take the meat off the bone for residents who need it.
d7.temp: Chicken to at least 165°F (175°F gives the most tender drumsticks).

d8.name: Spaghetti with meat sauce and Parmesan, green beans, salad
steps: Brown the beef in 1 Tbsp oil with 1 tsp salt and pepper, breaking it up. Add the diced onion and cook until soft; add 5 minced garlic cloves.
Stir in the tomato paste, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp basil, the tomatoes (crush them with a spoon), and 1 tsp sugar.
Partly cover and simmer on low 30–40 minutes, stirring now and then.
Boil the spaghetti until soft; drain. For easier eating, break the spaghetti in half before boiling.
Serve the sauce over pasta with Parmesan, green beans and salad.
d8.temp: Ground beef to 155°F; reheat leftovers to 165°F.

d9.name: Roasted bone-in chicken breast, roasted potatoes, corn, dinner roll
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Rub 5 large split chicken breasts with 3 Tbsp oil, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp paprika, salt and pepper.
Toss potato chunks with oil, salt and pepper on a second pan.
Roast chicken skin-side up 40–50 minutes; roast the potatoes alongside, turning once.
Rest the chicken 5 minutes, then carve each breast off the bone into 2 portions.
Serve with the potatoes and buttered corn.

d10.name: Herb-butter roast chicken, mashed potatoes, glazed carrots, dinner roll
steps: Heat oven to 450°F. Pat two 4.5 lb chickens dry. Mix 10 Tbsp melted butter with 4 minced garlic cloves, sage, rosemary, parsley, salt and pepper.
Put quartered onions in two roasting pans with 1 cup broth each. Set a chicken on top, lemon quarters inside, and spoon the herb butter over and under the skin.
Roast 10 minutes, lower to 350°F and roast about 1 hour 15 minutes more, basting twice. Rest 15 minutes, then carve.
Boil and mash the potatoes with 5 Tbsp butter and warm milk. Simmer sliced carrots until soft and toss with a little of the pan juices.
Serve chicken with pan juices, mashed potatoes and carrots.
d10.temp: Chicken to 165°F in the thickest part of the thigh.

d11.name: Beef and rice stuffed bell peppers with cheese, salad, dinner roll
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Cook the rice. Cut the tops off the peppers and remove the seeds; stand them in a baking dish.
Brown the beef with the chopped onion in 1 Tbsp oil; add 3 minced garlic cloves. Drain the fat.
Stir in the rice, 2 cans diced tomatoes, 1/2 can tomato sauce, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, salt, pepper and half the cheese. Fill the peppers.
Pour the remaining tomato sauce around the peppers. Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes at 400°F, then 20 minutes at 350°F.
Uncover, top with the rest of the cheese and bake 10–15 minutes until the peppers are soft. Serve with salad and a roll.

d12.name: Brown sugar glazed ham, scalloped potatoes, green beans, dinner roll
steps: Heat oven to 325°F. Place the ham cut-side down in a pan, brush with 2 Tbsp Dijon mixed with 1/4 cup orange or pineapple juice, cover with foil and bake 12–15 minutes per pound.
Simmer 1/2 cup juice, the brown sugar, 2 Tbsp Dijon, 1/4 tsp ginger and 2 tsp cornstarch until syrupy. Brush over the ham for the last 15 minutes at 425°F.
Scalloped potatoes (start first, 375°F): layer thinly sliced potatoes and onion with the cheese in a buttered 9×13 dish. Warm cream, milk, butter, garlic, 1 tsp salt and pepper and pour over.
Bake the potatoes covered 1 hour, then uncovered 30–45 minutes until tender and golden.
Slice the ham thin. Serve with scalloped potatoes and green beans. This plate is high in sodium.
d12.temp: Fully cooked ham reheated to 140°F; pork products 155°F under ADHS rule.

fl1.name: Lean Cuisine Herb Roasted Chicken with potatoes and broccoli (frozen), dinner roll, apple slices
steps: Keep the entrées frozen (0°F or below) until you cook them. Buy the Herb Roasted Chicken variety, 8 oz.

Heat each tray by the package directions; in an 1100-watt microwave that is about 4 minutes on high, stir the vegetables, then about 2 minutes more. Heat trays one or two at a time so they cook evenly.
Check the centre with a thermometer and let stand 1 minute.
Plate the meal off the tray, cut the chicken into bite-size pieces, and serve with a buttered roll and apple slices.

fl2.name: Lean Cuisine Meatloaf with mashed potatoes and gravy (frozen), side salad, orange wedges
steps: Keep the entrées frozen (0°F or below) until you cook them. Buy the Meatloaf with Mashed Potatoes variety, 9 3/8 oz.
Cut the film to vent and heat by the package directions; in an 1100-watt microwave that is about 4.5 minutes on high, stir the potatoes, then about 1.5 minutes more.
Check the centre with a thermometer and let stand 1 minute.
Plate the meal off the tray and serve with a small green salad and orange wedges.
label: Nutrition label

fd1.name: Stouffer's Classic Meatloaf with mashed potatoes and gravy (frozen), green beans, dinner roll
steps: Keep the entrées frozen (0°F or below) until you cook them. Buy the Classic Meatloaf variety, 9 7/8 oz.
For 10 residents the oven is easier: heat to 350°F, leave the film on, set the trays on baking sheets and cook about 40 minutes. In the microwave, cook one tray about 6 minutes.
Check the centre with a thermometer and let stand 1 minute.
Plate the meal off the tray and serve with heated green beans and a buttered roll. This plate is high in sodium.

fd2.name: Stouffer's Lasagna with Meat & Sauce (frozen), side salad, dinner roll
steps: Keep the entrées frozen (0°F or below) until you cook them. Buy the Lasagna with Meat & Sauce variety, 10.5 oz.
For 10 residents the oven is easier: heat to 350°F, set the trays on baking sheets and cook about 40 to 48 minutes as the package directs. In the microwave, cook one tray about 7 minutes.
Check the centre with a thermometer and let stand 1 minute.
Plate the lasagna off the tray, cut into small pieces, and serve with a small green salad and a roll. This plate is high in sodium.

s1.name: Apple or pear slices
steps: Wash, core and slice thin just before serving.

s2.name: Yogurt cup
steps: Serve chilled.

s3.name: Cheese and crackers
steps: Cut each cheese slice in quarters and serve with 5–6 crackers.

s4.name: Soft oatmeal raisin cookies (2)
steps: Cream the softened butter with both sugars. Beat in the eggs, 1.5 tsp vanilla and 2 tsp molasses.
Stir in the flour, 3/4 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1/3 tsp salt, then the oats and raisins. Chill the dough 30 minutes.
Scoop 20 balls onto lined sheets. Bake at 350°F for 13 minutes; the centres should look slightly soft.
Cool on the pan 5 minutes.

s5.name: Deviled eggs (2 halves)
steps: Boil the eggs 14 minutes, cool in ice water and peel. Halve lengthwise.
Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, 1.5 tsp Dijon, 1.5 tsp cider vinegar, salt and pepper.
Spoon or pipe into the whites and dust with paprika. Keep chilled.

s6.name: Banana bread slice
steps: Make one loaf as in the breakfast banana bread recipe: cream butter and sugar, add eggs and 3 mashed bananas, fold in flour, 1 tsp baking soda and 1/2 tsp salt.
Bake at 350°F 55–60 minutes. Slice into 10.

s7.name: Mandarin orange
steps: Peel and section for residents who need help.

s8.name: Grapes, halved
steps: Wash and halve lengthwise.

s9.name: Cucumber slices with sour cream dip
steps: Slice the cucumbers thin. Stir a little dill, garlic powder and salt into the sour cream.
